prompt: As of 2024, at the time of his birth, what was the middle name of the U.S. president who won Alaska, graduated from Yale University, and had a son named Michael?
answer:
The president was **Gerald Ford**, who won Alaska in the 1976 election, attended Yale Law School, and had a son named Michael.

**At birth, his middle name was Lynch**: he was born **Leslie Lynch King Jr.** He was later renamed **Gerald Rudolph Ford Jr.**, so “Rudolph” was his later middle name.
